svg.title: Azure · Private ingress and private egress are separate paths
svg.desc: Application Gateway reaches App Service through an inbound private endpoint. App Service uses a separate delegated integration subnet to reach the SQL private endpoint. App Service and SQL remain outside the consumer VNet.
svg.text: Azure · Private ingress and private egress are separate paths
DEPLOYMENT VIEW / WAF → inbound endpoint → App Service → outbound integration
Link the app and SQL private
Enable it in the gateway, App Service plan and SQL tier. Keep serving capacity
after a zone loss and test connection retries during database failover.
App Service reduces server operations. Private Link adds endpoint and DNS
management. Use managed identity with database grants; private reachability
Solid arrows: labelled traffic or replication. Dashed arrows: policy/control. Conceptual design; assumptions and sources in the chapter.
